title: Innovation Strategy for the MUHC
dek: How a major health centre reframed innovation as institutional capability—not a side project.
aiSummary: This research brief examines how McGill University Health Centre transformed innovation from episodic pilots into a governed institutional capability. It analyzes governance redesign, portfolio logic, implementation risks, and growth opportunities across digital care, partnerships, and workforce innovation—with strategic implications for academic medical centres through 2030.
metaDescription: Research brief on MUHC innovation strategy: governance redesign, portfolio management, risks, and growth opportunities for academic health centres.
ogTitle: Innovation Strategy for the MUHC | DinaResearch
ogDescription: How a major health centre reframed innovation as institutional capability.
keyTakeaways: Innovation durability depends on governance, not pilot enthusiasm.
Portfolio logic beats project heroics in complex health networks.
Data architecture is a prerequisite for credible impact measurement.
Partnership ecosystems amplify translational research outcomes.
